text:
Maya Patel: hey team :wave: quick one — I'm pairing with a new SDR (Zoe) today and we hit two blockers: 1) voicemail drop templates in Aircall (we want 2 variations: prospecting + follow-up), and 2) HubSpot seat mapping so her calls show up on the right team dashboard. I tried the self-serve seat request but it errored. who should I ping to get both set up fast?
Riley (salesops): hey! I can do both. for voicemail: we keep templates in the shared drive -> Sales/Voicemail-Templates. I'll paste the two copy variants here so you can test: 
- Prospecting: "Hey, this is Zoe from Redwood Inference — we help teams get production-grade LLM inference without the ops headache. Give me a ring at 555-0102 or reply to book 15m."
- Follow-up: "Hi, Zoe again from Redwood Inference. Just circling back on my note about improving LLM inference latency/cost. If now's a better time, call me at 555-0102 or reply with a time."
Riley (salesops): for Aircall voicemail drops we use the 'Voicemail > Templates' section. steps: 1) Settings -> Voicemail -> Templates -> New Template; 2) paste copy; 3) enable for "SDR - Outbound" cassette. if you want, I can add Zoe directly. I need her seat email.
Maya Patel: thanks! Zoe's email is zoe@redwood.dev. can you also double-check the tagging so calls appear under "SDR-East" pipeline?
Riley (salesops): yep. I'll create templates and add Zoe to the Outbound cassette. for HubSpot seat mapping: we map users to teams via SalesOps Mapping (internal sheet) and then trigger the provisioning job. the job sometimes fails if the user isn't in GSuite or if the org tag is missing. what error did you see when you tried?
Maya Patel: it said "mapping_job_failed: owner_not_found" when I submitted via the self-serve.
Riley (salesops): that usually means their Google account isn't in the Redwood org yet. @access-bot can you check provisioning for zoe@redwood.dev?
access-bot: Provisioning check for zoe@redwood.dev: Google account not found in org. Next steps: 1) send invite to GSuite (admin action) — request ticket created: #PROV-7842, link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROV-7842 ; 2) once user accepts, SalesOps will run the seat mapping job (ETA ~ 20m).
Maya Patel: ah got it. how do I escalate if we need this within the hour for a demos block?
Riley (salesops): if it's urgent, escalate the ticket with "URGENT: new-hire demo block" and ping me + Omar. I'll also pre-create the HubSpot mapping as a draft so once the GSuite accept happens it's a single click.
Jared (AE): also +1 for the voicemail variations — can you add a very short version (10s) for cold drops? something like: "Zoe from Redwood Inference — quick note on speeding up LLM inference. Call 555-0102."
Riley (salesops): good call. adding short cold drop now.
Omar (SRE): FYI: if you need Aircall API keys for automated drops, don't share long-lived keys in public. we have a short-lived token generator in the infra portal: https://infra.redwood.internal/tokens — ping me if you need script help.
Maya Patel: perfect, thanks everyone. Riley — can you DM me when templates are live and when the PROV ticket moves? I'll keep Zoe in the loop. :thumbsup:
Riley (salesops): will do. tagging the checklist so this thread is the source of truth: 
```
- create 3 voicemail templates (prospecting, follow-up, short cold)
- add Zoe to Aircall Outbound cassette
- open PROV-7842, request GSuite invite
- pre-create HubSpot seat mapping draft
- run mapping job after GSuite accept
```
Riley (salesops): ETA 25 minutes, unless GSuite invite is delayed.
access-bot: Ticket PROV-7842 updated: invited zoe@redwood.dev to Google Workspace. Status: invited.
Maya Patel: fantastic — thanks for the quick help :raised_hands:
Jared (AE): appreciate it, Maya. small thing — when you test the drops, can you confirm the voicemail player shows the right caller ID? we had one case last month where it displayed the shared number instead of the region-specific one.
Riley (salesops): good note. I'll set the caller ID to SDR-East pool. will report back in this thread.
Maya Patel: ok closing out once Zoe confirms calls are flowing. thanks all! :sparkles:
